title: blob_exists does not validate blob_id; relies entirely on caller discipline
description: kith-attach/src/lib.rs:65-66: blob_exists calls self.blob_path(id).exists() which has only a debug_assert\! (stripped in release builds) for path-traversal safety. Every other public entry point (write_blob, read_blob, delete_blob) explicitly calls validate_blob_id before blob_path. blob_exists is the only exception, relying on its doc comment ('callers must validate first') as the only guard. A future caller that skips validation silently introduces a filesystem oracle. Add explicit validate_blob_id call at the top of blob_exists.
